display_long_description:
A completely mobile XR Recording Studio for Quest, play in VR, MR or Enhanced VR Video Modes.

The biggest and most advanced XR music app ever built, with many new features. 
You can now play in time, with the fastest, lowest latency instruments in XR, 
Dynamic multi-sample Sounds, using variable Haptics and 3D Audio Visuals.

Includes Drums, Percussion, Bodhran, Acoustic, Electric and Bass Guitars, Full-scale Grand Piano, 2 Sampler Keyboards, Click Track, 8-Track Sequencer,
Full Sound Generation Synthesizer, blending 4 Oscillators, 8 Waveforms, ADSR, Effects, and 4 Low Frequency Oscillators.

Separated Vocal and Instrument Audio Recordings. 
Mic and HeadPhone Note/Frequency Detection. 
Mix your recorded audio clips and Master with the built in 8-Track XR DAW.

Drums XR MIDI system (learn by following hands, teach, record and playback).

Playback Audio using Music Player, Spatial Audio Sphere, or Stereo Splitting Spatializor with a Giant PA System.

Playback of 2D, VR180 or 360 Videos.

Write, Save and Load Lyrics with the in-app Computer Text Writer.
Upload and use your own music, samples, video image and text files.

Easy to use for beginner or pro, with guides for each module.

The successor to Instrument Studio VR for Rift, with ISXR the journey continues, with much more to come...

Stop reading and go make some noise!!
